subject: Pen test: authn & session-management findings — remediation schedule and evidence ETA
messages:
From: RedTeam Labs <redteam@redteamlabs.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test delivery + high-risk auth/session findings

Hi Marissa / Redwood team,

Attached is the final penetration test report (PT_Report_20270131.pdf) and a findings CSV (findings-summary.csv). We observed two high-risk issues impacting session management and authentication flows:

- CVE-analogue: session fixation on legacy auth endpoint (/v1/login) allowing token reuse after redirect chains.
- Missing secure attributes on auth cookies and no SameSite enforcement for cross-site contexts.

We also left notes on insufficient logging around token issuance that prevents forensics. Full reproduction steps are in the PDF.

Requesting:
- Confirmation of scope (you already got the report)
- Initial ETA for remediation of high-risk items
- An account for retest or a retest window once fixes are staged

We’ll keep the retest flexible but recommend a two-week window after deployment.

Attachments: PT_Report_20270131.pdf (report), findings-summary.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
Lead Consultant, RedTeam Labs
redteam@redteamlabs.io

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: RedTeam Labs <redteam@redteamlabs.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test delivery + high-risk auth/session findings

Hi Tom / team,

Thanks for the report and the clear reproduction steps — we have it and have triaged the two high-risk findings. Quick notes from triage:

- Session fixation: repro relies on redirect handling in the legacy auth flow only (internal flagging as legacy-auth).
- Cookie attributes: a few services are missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite settings on the session cookie; some are served from the legacy domain.
- Logging: token issuance events are not consistently emitted to audit logs (specifically for client_id=mobile).

Action plan (high level):
1) Create Jira issues and assign to the auth team.
   - INF-8421: session-fixation-mitigation (regenerate tokens on redirect, tighten redirect allowlist)
   - INF-8422: session-cookie-hardening + logging (set Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite, emit token-issue audit event)
2) Engineering to deliver a patch and smoke test in staging.
3) Schedule retest with RedTeam after deployment.

Proposed ETAs:
- Target PRs opened by 2027-02-18
- Staging rollout by 2027-02-28
- Hotfix/production deploy by 2027-03-03 (contingent on successful staging validation)
- Retest window: 2027-03-07 to 2027-03-11

Vivek — can you confirm assignment and whether the proposed dates look feasible from an engineering capacity view?

Marissa / Laura — we’ll prepare a remediation evidence checklist (config screenshots, smoke-test logs, retest plan) once PRs are ready.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test delivery + high-risk auth/session findings

Thanks — I’ve reviewed the triage and assigned tickets to the auth team. Technical summary and commitments:

- Session fixation (INF-8421):
  * Implement token regeneration on every redirect to auth callback and add an allowlist for redirect URIs.
  * Add server-side validation to reject reused tokens older than 60s for the legacy flow.

- Cookie hardening & logging (INF-8422):
  * Set cookie flags Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax for cross-site compat, update CDN cookie policy.
  * Emit audit events on token issuance/refresh (audit.topic:auth.token.issue). Events will be shipped to our logging cluster with retention matching SOC2 needs.

Timeline and deliverables:
- PRs created: by 2027-02-18 (expected 2 PRs + unit tests)
- Staging rollout & smoke tests: 2027-02-28 to 2027-03-01
- Production deploy (canary -> global): 2027-03-03
- Evidence to share after prod:
  1) Patch diffs and PR links (patch-plan-INF8421.pdf)
  2) Staging smoke-test logs and screenshots
  3) Updated config snippets showing cookie flags

We will prepare the evidence bundle and upload to the shared drive folder (link below) once the PRs are merged. If RedTeam needs an earlier retest date we can prioritize a hotfix but would prefer the above cadence to ensure test coverage.

Attachments: patch-plan-INF8421.pdf (patch plan and diffs)
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8422

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Acme Corp Security <sec@acme.com>, RedTeam Labs <redteam@redteamlabs.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test delivery + high-risk auth/session findings — remediation update for Acme

Hi team,

Quick consolidated update for Acme following RedTeam’s report and our internal triage:

What we’re fixing
- Session fixation in legacy flow: token regeneration and redirect allowlist (INF-8421).
- Cookie flagging and logging gaps: Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite + token-issue audit events (INF-8422).

Planned timeline (confirmed by engineering):
- PRs opened: 2027-02-18
- Staging validation: 2027-02-28
- Prod deploy (canary then global): 2027-03-03
- Retest (by RedTeam): week of 2027-03-07

What evidence you will receive
- Patch diffs and PR links (we’ll attach patch-plan-INF8421.pdf).
- Staging smoke-test logs and screenshots.
- Config snippets showing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite enforcement.
- Final retest report from RedTeam (when completed).
- Evidence checklist will be uploaded as evidence-delivery-checklist.xlsx to the shared folder.

If you need a faster remediation, we can request a hotfix; please let me know by EOD PST 2027-02-15 and I’ll escalate. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the dates above and deliver the evidence bundle into the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEXAMPLE

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
